title: Bearing the heavenly image
english: He is the image of the invisible God, the firstborn of all creation (Colossians 1:15). Whoever goes out of this world bearing the image of the earthly one is reduced to nothing in the city of God; let him carry back the marks of the heavenly image.
translator_notes: Copy-text PG 12 (Migne) Rufinus Latin via Archive PDF pdftotext; no first-edition GCS.
True OET: no ANF; do not copy Trigg FOTC / Prinzivalli SC / Perrone 2015.
After tip 768df8e8; Psalms Rufinus Homilia II in Ps 38 CLOSEOUT.
orientation: Origen is closing the homily on Psalm 38 by contrasting the earthly image, which perishes, with the heavenly image of Christ, the firstborn of all creation.

title: Final prayer of the sojourner
english: “I am a sojourner with you and a pilgrim, like all my fathers. Forgive me, so that I may be refreshed before I depart” (Psalm 39:12–13, LXX 38:13–14). Glory to Christ Jesus forever. Amen.
translator_notes: Copy-text PG 12 (Migne) Rufinus Latin via Archive PDF pdftotext; no first-edition GCS.
True OET: no ANF; do not copy Trigg FOTC / Prinzivalli SC / Perrone 2015.
After tip 768df8e8; Psalms Rufinus Homilia II in Ps 38 CLOSEOUT.
orientation: Origen closes the homily by quoting the psalmist's final prayer, then adds a doxology to Christ Jesus.
